_format: Keys are SEC CIKs (zero padding optional). Each entry pins the XBRL revenue concept for that company and must cite the filing it was validated against, e.g. {"0000875320": {"ticker": "VRTX", "concept": "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax", "validated_against": "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/875320/...", "reason": "..."}}. Use only to resolve cases the pipeline flags as ambiguous.
